headline_marked: [[New Orleans tests AI for 911 calls]] to triage emergencies, reduce human dispatcher load
headline: New Orleans tests AI for 911 calls to triage emergencies, reduce human dispatcher load
summary: The AI system, already used for 311 calls, aims to divert non-urgent 911 calls during surges, routing callers to an AI agent for incident-related information or transferring them to a human for new emergencies.
details: New Orleans is implementing Carbyne's AI Emergency Call Triage for 911 calls, aiming to reduce the daily volume human dispatchers handle, which is over a thousand calls. This follows a successful April rollout where AI began answering 311 non-emergency calls.

The AI system assesses incoming calls and can provide immediate feedback. It is designed to handle multiple calls related to a single incident, routing callers to an AI agent for updates or transferring them to a human if their call is unrelated.

The Orleans Parish Communication District (OPCD) states the AI will only direct calls, not handle actual emergencies. This strategy combats call pile-ups and aims to improve response times by freeing human dispatchers for critical incidents.

While AI can boost efficiency, potential risks exist. These include the AI developing hidden biases from historical data, which could reinforce systemic racism, or failing to understand diverse accents and dialects due to limitations in automatic speech recognition.

Effective implementation requires human oversight, thorough training data, strong cybersecurity, and algorithm regulation. Without proper monitoring, AI can be unreliable, and outcomes are not always guaranteed.

headline_marked: [[Trevor Noah to host Google's Pixel 11 launch event]] on August 12th in NYC
headline: Trevor Noah to host Google's Pixel 11 launch event on August 12th in NYC
summary: Google's upcoming Made by Google event will feature new Pixel 11 phones and smartwatches, along with a lineup of celebrities and influencers, signaling a push for mainstream appeal.
details: Google has officially announced that comedian Trevor Noah will host its next Made by Google hardware launch event. The show is scheduled for August 12th and will take place in New York City, starting at 6 PM ET.

The event video also teases appearances from other celebrities and influencers. These include Call Her Daddy host Alex Cooper, Indian cricketer Shubman Gill, Japanese actress Ayami Nakajo, and NBA star Stephen Curry.

This celebrity-heavy approach follows last year's event, which was hosted by Jimmy Fallon and aimed for a mainstream audience. Google appears to be continuing this strategy to broaden its reach beyond traditional tech enthusiasts.

Attendees can expect glimpses of new hardware, with the teaser video showing a new phone and smartwatch. Google has previously hinted at the Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro Fold, though leaks suggest a higher price tag for the upcoming gadgets.
